articles.title: England amputee team's World Cup dream on hold
articles.summary: Former head coach Scott Rogers has said it is "criminal" that England men's amputee football team could miss the 2026 World Cup due to a lack of funding.

articles.title: The defining moments of the 2026 World Cup
articles.summary: From historic World Cup debuts and emotional first victories, to new stars and the brilliance of legends - relive the defining moments of the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

articles.title: Watch the BBC's closing World Cup montage
articles.summary: Watch the closing montage of the BBC's coverage of the 2026 Fifa World Cup featuring all the highs, lows and colour from the biggest World Cup ever.

articles.title: Norway consider complaint over Balogun World Cup ban suspension
articles.summary: The Norwegian Football Federation is considering filing a formal complaint to Fifa's ethics committee.

articles.title: F1 considering Malaysian GP return as 2026 replacement race
articles.summary: Formula 1 bosses are in talks with organisers of the Malaysian Grand Prix to see the Sepang race make a surprise return to the calendar this year as a stand-in event.
